disclaimer: 本报告是对 DBLP-ACM（独立学术引文基准，Leipzig DB Group 自 2010 年维护，与 USAspending/TED/GLEIF 无关）的泛化检验，不替代 Task 238 的三项外部依赖（隐藏题集/真实 query log、两名非开发者独立评审、授权真实工作流）。
limitations: This is title-string matching on academic citation records, not organization/company identity resolution; it tests whether the GLEIF finding generalizes across domains, not whether it applies directly to the ontology's business entities.
Hard negatives are same-venue/same-year paper pairs, a stress-test construction, not a production prevalence estimate.
Positive pairs come from the dataset's published gold mapping, an academic ground truth; it is not a substitute for the two-non-developer identity adjudication required by the research plan.
